issue.title: Planning — Pre-development Architecture Study
issue.body:
This issue tracks the initial architecture study and planning spike for the Fluent Mobile app before Stage 1 implementation begins.

Scope of study:

- Auth0 offline-first authentication strategy (refresh tokens, secure storage, session handling)
- Database sync architecture: PostgreSQL (parent) ↔ PowerSync ↔ OpSQLite (local)
- Hono backend integration — new endpoints needed for mobile (mutations, PowerSync JWT, audio upload)
- Audio file storage strategy ?
- Bidirectional data flow and conflict resolution approach
- Open questions to resolve before Stage 1 (hosting, token lifetimes, sync scope)


DEV  ( Joel)

This will be a R& D scoped Issue 
- Authentication - 5 Hours
- DB - 4 Hours
- Syncing - 5 hours
- Db schema- 5 hours
- Architecture development - 4  hours
- Audio storage - 4 hours
- Creating docs - 5 hours
- Discussions with team - 5 hours
- Rehashing and more research - 4 hours
